statusbar.themeTitle: {{label}}. Click to switch to {{next}}. To follow the system, change it in Settings.
statusbar.themeTitleAuto: Following the system ({{label}}). Click to switch to {{next}}.

dialog.unexpectedError:
NyaMark encountered an unexpected error: {{message}}

If something stops working, save your documents and restart NyaMark.

imagePolicy.title: Choose where to save pasted images
imagePolicy.subtitle: Choose a rule. Screenshots you paste later are saved by this rule automatically.

unsavedImage.title: Save this document before inserting pasted images
unsavedImage.subtitle: Screenshots have no original file path. Save the document first, or embed the image as Base64.

fileConflict.title: File changed on disk
fileConflict.body: "{{fileName}}" was modified by another app. Do you want to reload it and discard your unsaved changes?

copyTarget.title: Copy images outside the document folder?
copyTarget.body: This document’s front matter asks for images to be copied to "{{directory}}", which is outside the document’s folder. Allow this, or use your attachment settings instead?

unsavedChanges.title: Unsaved changes
unsavedChanges.body: Do you want to save the changes you made to "{{fileName}}"? Your changes will be lost if you don’t save them.

attachmentError.base64TooLarge: The image is {{size}} MB, which exceeds the {{limit}} MB limit for Base64 embedding. Save the document first, then copy the image into a folder.
attachmentError.documentTooLarge: Embedding this image would make the document larger than {{limit}} MB, and NyaMark could no longer open it. Save the document first, then copy the image into a folder.

documentError.notUtf8: "{{fileName}}" is not UTF-8 encoded and was not modified. Convert it to UTF-8, then open it again.
documentError.notUtf8Known: "{{fileName}}" uses the {{encoding}} encoding and was not modified. NyaMark edits UTF-8 files only. Convert it to UTF-8, then open it again.
documentError.forbidden: NyaMark doesn’t have permission to access "{{fileName}}".
documentError.readOnly: "{{fileName}}" is read-only and was not modified. Use Save As to save your changes to another file.
documentError.tooLarge: "{{fileName}}" is larger than {{limit}} MB, the largest file NyaMark can edit.
documentError.changed: "{{fileName}}" was changed by another app after NyaMark read it, so NyaMark left it unchanged. Use Save As to save this document.

exportPdf.title: Export to PDF
exportPdf.subtitle: Export "{{fileName}}" to PDF with the settings below.

settingsReset.title: Settings were reset
settingsReset.body: NyaMark couldn’t read its settings file and is using the default settings. The original file was kept at "{{path}}".

updates.title: A new version of NyaMark is available
updates.subtitle: You have {{current}}. {{latest}} is now available.
updates.failed: Unable to install {{latest}}. Download it manually from the download page.
updates.installed: {{latest}} is installed and will take effect after NyaMark restarts.
updates.upToDate: You are running the latest version, {{version}}.
updates.checkFailed: Check your network connection and try again.
updates.feedMissing: The update server has not provided version information yet. Try again later.
updates.saveFirst: {{latest}} has been downloaded. NyaMark quits during installation, so save your documents before you click Install now.
updates.noReleaseNotes: No release notes were provided for this version.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Adjust how the editor looks and behaves.
settings.confirmResetBody: This will restore appearance, auto-save, and attachment options to their defaults. This action cannot be undone.

use-path.label: Keep original path
use-path.description: Link to the image where it is, without copying it.

copy-same-folder.label: Document folder
copy-same-folder.description: Copy the image into the document’s folder.

copy-assets.label: ./assets
copy-assets.description: Copy the image into an assets folder next to the document.

copy-custom-folder.label: Custom folder
copy-custom-folder.description: Copy the image into the folder chosen below.

base64.label: Embed as Base64
base64.description: Embed the image in the document as Base64.

ai.servicesNote: Add the AI services you use. Keys are stored in the system keychain and are sent only to the address they were saved for.
ai.fileStorage: No keychain is available on this system. Keys are stored unencrypted in a file that only the current user can read.
ai.name: Name
ai.badUrl: Enter an address that starts with https:// or http://.
ai.plainHttp: This address uses an unencrypted HTTP connection, so the key is sent over the network in plain text. Use HTTPS if the service supports it.
ai.keyNeeded: The address now points to a different site. Enter the key again.
ai.keySaved: Saved ••••{{hint}}. Paste a new key to replace it

chatgpt.title: ChatGPT account
chatgpt.about: Requests to this service are sent through Codex and use the usage included in the ChatGPT plan. Sign-in takes place on chatgpt.com in the browser.
chatgpt.notRevoked: Signed out of NyaMark, but ChatGPT could not be reached to end the session. To end it, sign out of all devices in ChatGPT’s security settings.

page.signedIn: NyaMark is now signed in. You can close this page and return to NyaMark.
page.failed: NyaMark was unable to complete sign-in. Return to NyaMark to see the reason.

error.signedOut: This service is signed out of ChatGPT. Sign in again.
error.signInAgain: The ChatGPT sign-in has expired. Sign in again.
error.accessDenied: The sign-in request was denied in the browser.
error.noCodex: Codex is not enabled for this ChatGPT workspace. Contact the workspace administrator to enable it, or sign in with another account.
error.portsBusy: Ports 1455 and 1457, which sign-in requires, are both in use, possibly by a Codex sign-in. Complete or quit that sign-in, then try again.
error.store: Unable to read or save the ChatGPT sign-in information: {{message}}

ai.failed: Unable to load the model list: {{message}}
ai.notConnected: no key or address has been saved for this service
ai.modelSearch: Search models or enter a model ID to add
ai.unlisted: This service does not provide a model list. {{model}} responded.
ai.waitSignIn: The model list loads after you sign in.
ai.waitKey: The model list loads after an API key is entered.
ai.waitUrl: The model list loads after a service address is entered.
ai.noModels: No models. Enter a model ID above to add one.
ai.instructionsNote: Included with every request, such as writing conventions, the language for replies, or content that should stay unchanged.
ai.searchNote: No search API key is required: NyaMark reads the web search results of Bing and DuckDuckGo directly. Automatic tries each in turn.
ai.nativeSearch: Prefer the provider’s built-in web search
ai.nativeSearchNote: Anthropic and OpenAI run searches on their servers and charge for each search. For other providers, NyaMark runs the search.

mcp.title: MCP servers
mcp.note: MCP servers provide additional tools to the assistant. A local server runs programs on this computer with the current user’s permissions; add only servers you trust. Changes take effect after you click OK.
mcp.envNote: Enter one NAME=value per line. Environment variables are stored as plain text in the settings file.
mcp.headersNote: Enter one Name: value per line. Headers are stored as plain text in the settings file; a token entered in the key field below is stored in the system keychain.
mcp.useKey: Send a key with each request (Bearer)
mcp.toolsNote: The assistant asks for confirmation before running any other tool.

error.badCwd: The working folder does not exist: {{detail}}
error.noKey: No key has been saved for this server.
error.timeout: The server did not respond in time.
error.badHeader: This request header is not valid: {{detail}}
error.reservedHeader: This request header is set by the connection automatically. Remove it from the list: {{detail}}
error.keyStore: Unable to read the saved key: {{detail}}
error.badProxy: The proxy address is not valid: {{detail}}
error.connection: Unable to connect to the server: {{detail}}

quick.title: AI menu commands
quick.note: Commands shown in the AI menu for a selection, in this order. A built-in command with a blank name or instruction uses its default.
quick.promptPlaceholder: For example: Turn this text into a bulleted list.

complete.title: Autocomplete
complete.note: After typing pauses, the model suggests the following text in gray after the insertion point. Press Tab to accept all of it, Cmd/Ctrl+→ to accept one word, or Esc to dismiss it. Each suggestion sends the text before and after the insertion point to the selected service.
complete.atEndOnly: Only at the end of a paragraph

history.title: Conversations
history.note: Conversations are stored in the app data on this computer and restored when the document is opened again. Conversations for unsaved documents are deleted when the window closes.
history.clearTitle: Do you want to delete all conversations?
history.clearConfirm: Saved conversations for all documents, and the images in them, will be deleted from this computer. This action cannot be undone.

ai.keyStore: Unable to read or save the key: {{message}}
ai.badProxy: The proxy address is not valid: {{message}}

ai.title: AI assistant
ai.resize: Drag to resize. Double-click to restore the default width.

setup.title: Connect an AI service
setup.body: Use an API key or a model on this computer. Keys are stored in the system keychain and are sent only to the address entered.
setup.more: Other services with an OpenAI-compatible API are also supported.

empty.title: Start a conversation
empty.body: The assistant can read this document and the notes in the same folder, and help draft, rewrite, and develop ideas.

error.noModel: Choose a model in AI settings.
error.notConnected: No key has been saved for this service. Enter it in AI settings.
error.keyNeeded: The service address has changed since the key was saved. Enter the key again in AI settings.
error.rateLimited: Too many requests, or the quota has been used up. Try again later.
error.network: Unable to connect to the service.
error.signedOut: This service is signed out of ChatGPT. Sign in again in AI settings.
error.renewFailed: Unable to renew the ChatGPT sign-in.
error.usageLimit: The usage limit of the ChatGPT plan has been reached. The reset time is shown in ChatGPT’s usage settings.
error.planUnavailable: The current ChatGPT plan does not include Codex. Upgrade to Plus or a higher plan, or use an API key.

edit.modeReviewNote: Edits are marked in the document and are applied only after you accept them.
edit.modeAutoNote: Edits are written to the document immediately. Each can be undone.

approval.folder: The assistant is requesting access to a notes folder
approval.page: Do you want to open a page on this computer or the local network?
approval.pageNote: Addresses like this can reach the router, local services, and other devices on the local network. If allowed, the assistant can open pages on {{host}} for the rest of this conversation.
approval.tool: Do you want to run {{tool}} from {{server}}?
approval.toolNote: MCP tools can read and modify content outside NyaMark. Review what will be sent to the tool.

ending.stepLimit: The reply reached the maximum number of steps. Send “continue” to resume.
ending.length: The reply reached the model’s length limit.
ending.filtered: This reply was filtered by the service.

image.limit_other: Each message can include up to {{count}} images.

reason.notImage: NyaMark cannot recognize it as an image
reason.forbidden: NyaMark does not have permission to read that location
reason.notFound: the file has been moved or deleted
reason.other: the file could not be read

image.noVision: {{model}} is not marked as supporting images, so the service may reject this request. If the model supports images, select Images for it in AI settings.

quick.title: AI menu
quick.placeholderSelection: Describe how to change the selection…
quick.notPlaced: The text where the reply was to be inserted has changed. Copy the reply and paste it manually.
quick.unchanged: The reply is identical to the original text.

history.empty: No saved conversations for this document
history.listFailed: Unable to read the saved conversations
